summary: Embed schema swap during proxy rolling causing incomplete rerank batches
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (Searchly Labs) reported a sudden increase in incomplete rerank responses and streaming disconnects starting 2026-03-10 02:10 UTC. Symptoms observed across multiple customers but concentrated on a handful of high-throughput dedicated tenants in us-east-1.

Impact:
- ~12% of rerank requests return partial candidate lists (top-K shorter than requested) or early termination of streaming response.
- Increased tail latency (p95/p99) for rerank pipeline; customer-facing error rate spike ~3.8%.
- Users see degraded search quality and intermittent "partial_topk" markers in responses.

Environment:
- Prod, us-east-1, Dedicated pool: dp-us-east-3
- Edge proxy fleet rolled from edge-proxy v7.14.1 -> v7.15.0 starting 2026-03-10 01:55 UTC.
- Affected services: embeddings-service (embedder-v2.1), reranker (reranker-lite-2025), edge-proxy (envoy-based).

Steps to reproduce (internal reproducer):
1. Send 50 concurrent rerank requests using embedder-v2.1 with batch size 64 and request header X-Embed-Version: v2.1.
2. Observe reranker response streaming; look for truncated candidate list or early stream close.
3. Replay through proxy instance that has rolled to v7.15.0.

Observed behavior:
- Proxy instances running v7.15.0 rewrite or drop the custom header X-Embed-Version intermittently under high concurrency.
- Embeddings-service returns 200 but with payload header "X-Embed-Schema: swapped" on a subset of responses; payload dims change from 512->768 for a fraction of in-flight requests.
- Reranker sees mismatched embedding length and responds with partial candidate lists and logs "partial_topk_due_to_embed_len_mismatch".
- Streaming connections frequently close with HTTP/2 RST_STREAM and code describing "payload_incomplete".

Expected behavior:
- Proxy should preserve custom headers and not alter embedding payload schema during rolling upgrades.
- Embeddings-service and reranker should negotiate or fail more explicitly rather than producing silent partial results.

Relevant logs / request ids:
- Customer sample request ids: req-20260310-ue9c, req-20260310-ueb2, req-20260310-uf33
- Proxy logs (edge-proxy-12): "WARN header_drop X-Embed-Version for req-20260310-ue9c under stream-pressure"
- Reranker logs (rr-07): "ERROR partial_topk_due_to_embed_len_mismatch for req-20260310-ue9c embed_len=768 expected=512"
- Embeddings trace (emb-3): "INFO embed_schema_tag swapped for req-20260310-ue9c; upstream header missing"
comments: 2026-03-10 03:05 UTC - Maya Patel (Support): Logged initial customer report and attached sample request IDs and example rerank responses. Escalated to SRE due to customer impact.

2026-03-10 03:22 UTC - Diego Alvarez (SRE): Noted proxy fleet upgrade at 01:55 UTC. Correlating proxy rollout window with error spike. Asked infra to freeze further rollouts and provide involved hostnames.

2026-03-10 04:11 UTC - Lina Chen (Customer Success, Searchly Labs): Provided additional request traces and confirmed degradation started at ~02:05 UTC; they routed traffic via dedicated pool dp-us-east-3.

2026-03-10 05:40 UTC - Diego Alvarez (SRE): Reproduced failure against a v7.15.0 proxy in staging. Observed intermittent header drop under synthetic load. Opened PR to add header-preserve flag: https://github.com/redwood/edge-proxy/pull/4123
2026-03-11 09:00 UTC - Product (Samir Rao): Requested timeline for fix and possible customer mitigation (pin to older proxy nodes or route around rolling cohort).
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Rolling upgrade introduced a change in proxy configuration that triggers header normalization under stream pressure, causing custom metadata headers (X-Embed-Version / X-Embed-Schema) to be dropped for some requests.

Hypothesis 2: Embeddings-service has a fallback path that, when header is missing, responds with an alternate schema (768-dim) but does not surface an error code; reranker expects a strict 512-dim and truncates candidates silently.

Trace correlation: Matched timestamps between proxy rollout, header-drop WARNs in proxy logs, embedding-service "embed_schema_tag swapped" markers, and reranker partial_topk errors. Strong time alignment across multiple hosts.
Metric check: rerank partial_topk rate rose from 0.2% -> 11.9% across dp-us-east-3 during rollout window. p99 latency increased from 420ms -> 2.1s for rerank requests.
Reproducer notes: In staging, hitting a v7.15.0 proxy under concurrency > 200 causes ~8-12% of requests to lose X-Embed-Version. Pinning to v7.14.1 eliminates the symptom.

Config diff: v7.15.0 default envoy config introduced HTTP/2 header compression adjustments and an aggressive 'header_buffer_limit_bytes' tuning. This appears to interact badly with our custom header preservation filter.

Risk assessment: High — affects quality (silent partial responses) and latency for dedicated customers. Data leakage risk low but operational risk high because issues are silent (no 5xx), making detection harder without observability on partial_topk metrics.

Workaround trial: Add middleware to explicitly set X-Embed-Version into request body when present; tested in staging and reduced partial_topk to baseline but has overhead and is not a long-term solution.

Related findings: A small subset of embed-producer clients do not include X-Embed-Version; with proxy dropping header these requests are indistinguishable and hit the fallback path — indicates need for stricter schema negotiation.
resolution_notes: Short-term mitigation (completed 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC): Halted v7.15.0 rollout in us-east-1. Rolled back affected proxy hosts to v7.14.1. Customer errors returned to baseline within ~30 minutes after rollback for dp-us-east-3.

Hotfix (in progress): PR #4123 adds explicit header-preserve middleware and increases header_buffer_limit_bytes with guardrails. Patch validated in staging with 5000 concurrent requests; header-drop rate reduced to <0.2%.
Planned fix: Coordinate with infra to issue v7.15.1 with header-preserve enabled and default config tuned. Will run canary at 5% traffic for 6 hours and monitor partial_topk and p99 latency.

Customer communication: CS sent interim mitigation notes to Searchly Labs (Lina Chen). Offering a temporary route pin to avoid rolling cohorts and a credit for impacted minutes. Scheduled follow-up call 2026-03-12 16:00 UTC.

Postmortem actions (to-do):
- Add schema-negotiation handshake between client->proxy->embedder to fail explicit on mismatch (TKT INT-4420).
- Add metric and alert for "partial_topk" counts and embed-length-mismatch in reranker.
- Update rolling runbook to include header-preservation verification step and load-check before canary expansion.
- Audit embed clients to ensure X-Embed-Version header present by default.
Status: Hotfix validated in staging; production rollout pending after canary and sign-off from Infra and Reranker owners.
